next.reason: 1985: 'ASSIGN TO { implementor-name-1 | literal-1 } … RECORD KEY IS data-name-1 [ ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS data-name-2 [ WITH DUPLICATES ] ]'; 2023: '[ USING data-name-1 ] … record-key-name-1 SOURCE IS { data-name-3 } … [ SUPPRESS WHEN literal-2 ] … LOCK MODE IS … SHARING WITH'. 2023 Format 1 keeps every 1985 element but adds ASSIGN USING, SOURCE keys, SUPPRESS WHEN, COLLATING SEQUENCE, LOCK MODE and SHARING, so more programs are accepted.
